name: Protocol or adapter proposal
about: Propose a specific behavior, integration, or protocol change
title: "Proposal: "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## User need

Describe the interaction in plain language and who benefits.

## Existing options

How do A2A, MCP, Airshower, or another project handle it today? Include primary sources where possible.

## Proposed behavior

Give a concrete request and response example. Identify the owner, agent, permission scope, and any human decision.

## Failure and compatibility

What happens when a participant is offline, retries, cancels, or revokes permission? What could this disclose or allow? Does it change the wire format?

## Verification

What reproducible result would demonstrate that the proposal works? Name independently testable acceptance criteria.
